readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. Reach additionally fails on a cold executable whole line inside a reached range. The direct coordinator tests pin the exact bracket/exhaustion-jump/bisection request sequence, discontinuity nonconvergence, gross ACA fallback, both conflicting-basin directions, HECM probe reset, frozen root/ACA/HECM inputs, and exact selected-object identity. The hostile delegation test separately injects non-economic accepted evaluation, cash, HECM, convergence, residual, and ACA-flag values and proves simulatePlan consumes the coordinator result instead of recomputing the root.
